The microneedling page lists mesotherapy at $55 while the Sylfirm X page lists it at $50 — $50 is used for the Sylfirm context, $55 was not used. TrustAnalytica aggregator price ranges were NOT used. The clinic publishes its city as St. Louis, MO 63117; 35 The Boulevard is in Richmond Heights — city filed as St. Louis per the clinic's own published address. Modern 'facial and Botox bar' concept; $75 deposit required to book.
